thread:
marie: preflight hook failing on canary for gpupool chart in us-west-2, helm hangs at preinstall. seen by anyone?
reza: saw it in CI logs — hook pod Pending, kubelet says "no nodes available that match nodeAffinity". suspect node label mismatch after last infra change.
sam: confirmed — terraform refactor changed node label from gpu.redwood.com/pool=nvlink to gpu.redwood.com/pool=nvlink-v2. GitOps applied chart but nodes still have old label on two instances.
jada: hook logic: it waits for GPUPool CR to be migrated AND for nodeSelector match before proceeding. since selector changed, hook times out at 10m -> helm rollback. logs: ```
$ helm upgrade --install gpupool ./charts/gpupool --wait --timeout 10m
Hook preinstall/gpupool-preflight failed: pod gpupool-preflight-abc-123 is Pending
kubectl -n kube-system logs gpupool-preflight-abc-123
Waiting for nodes matching selector: gpu.redwood.com/pool=nvlink
```
ci-bot: release-bot initiated automatic rollback after hook timeout (rollback 1/1).
reza: quick mitigation option: patch nodes to have the new label or make hook accept both labels. commands I ran locally: ```
kubectl label node ip-10-0-1-23 gpu.redwood.com/pool=nvlink-v2 --overwrite
kubectl label node ip-10-0-1-24 gpu.redwood.com/pool=nvlink-v2 --overwrite
```
sam: alternative quick patch to GPUPool CR (if chart/controller tolerates it): ```
kubectl patch gpupool my-gpupool -n infra --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/nodeSelector/gpu.redwood.com~1pool","value":"nvlink-v2"}]'
```
marie: can we just skip the preflight hook for this canary? it's blocking the rollout and it's a non-critical selector change.
release-bot: ArgoCD: paused sync for apps/gpupool-canary per request from @marie.
jada: long-term fix items: 1) make preflight tolerant (check both legacy and new labels, or query nodes by instance-type fallback); 2) bump hook timeout to 15m and add exponential backoff; 3) add TF plan guardrail to avoid label drift during nodepool changes; 4) add alert on "preflight hook failed" to PagerDuty.
marie: i'll open a tracker and coordinate on labels + chart change. INF-4321 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 : i'll own the canary rollback and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
